ALTER TABLE teacher_context_summary
    ADD COLUMN invalidation_epoch SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
        CHECK (invalidation_epoch IN (1, 2));

-- Rows created before the durable Dialog mutation subscriber cannot prove that
-- no compacted-away message was edited or deleted. Invalidate them once and
-- keep epoch 1 unusable; current application writes epoch 2 only.
UPDATE teacher_context_summary
SET invalidated_at = GREATEST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_at, updated_at),
    updated_at = GREATEST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, created_at, updated_at),
    revision = revision + 1
WHERE invalidated_at IS NULL;

ALTER TABLE teacher_context_summary
    ALTER COLUMN invalidation_epoch SET DEFAULT 2;

CREATE TABLE teacher_dialog_context_mutation_inbox (
    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    event_type VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK (event_type = 'dialog.teacher.context-mutated'),
    schema_version SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (schema_version = 1),
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    event_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (event_sequence > 0),
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    context_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (context_type IN ('general', 'lesson', 'lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    context_id UUID NOT NULL,
    message_id UUID NOT NULL,
    message_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (message_sequence > 0),
    message_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (message_version > 0),
    last_event_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (last_event_sequence = event_sequence AND last_event_sequence >= message_sequence),
    mutation VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (mutation IN ('updated', 'deleted')),
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    advanced BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    invalidated BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    CHECK (
        (context_type = 'general' AND context_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
        OR
        (context_type <> 'general' AND context_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
    )
);

CREATE TABLE teacher_dialog_context_mutation_fence (
    student_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    personal_teacher_id UUID NOT NULL,
    dialog_id UUID NOT NULL,
    context_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    context_id UUID NOT NULL,
    message_id UUID NOT NULL,
    message_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (message_sequence > 0),
    message_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (message_version > 0),
    last_event_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (last_event_sequence >= message_sequence),
    mutation VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (mutation IN ('updated', 'deleted')),
    event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES teacher_dialog_context_mutation_inbox(event_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    processed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (student_id, personal_teacher_id, dialog_id, context_type, context_id, message_id),
    CHECK (btrim(student_id) <> ''),
    CHECK (context_type IN ('general', 'lesson', 'lesson_task', 'practice_task', 'project')),
    CHECK (
        (context_type = 'general' AND context_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
        OR
        (context_type <> 'general' AND context_id <> '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)
    )
);

CREATE INDEX teacher_dialog_context_mutation_fence_summary_idx
    ON teacher_dialog_context_mutation_fence (
        student_id, personal_teacher_id, dialog_id, context_type, context_id,
        message_sequence, last_event_sequence
    );
